cases.input: Two instances pin variants A and B of process D version 2.0.
cases.expect: Both traces replay independently without treating variants as supersession.

cases.input: A work item is offered then expires with no step execution.
cases.expect: Assignment history remains valid and no performed act is inferred.

cases.input: A step runs out of sequence and a compensating execution follows.
cases.expect: Deviation and both executions are append-only and replayable.

cases.input: Released procedure 3.0 is edited after a completed instance.
cases.expect: Rejected; release 3.1 as a successor and preserve the completed trace pins.

cases.input: Edition 4.0 is published but no adopter record is effective.
cases.expect: Existing processes continue to resolve their prior adopted edition.

cases.input: Edition 4.0 becomes effective between two step starts.
cases.expect: Earlier execution pins 3.0 and later execution pins 4.0 with no rewrite.

cases.input: A BPMN branch exists but no execution event was observed.
cases.expect: No claim that the branch was traversed; coverage remains explicit.
